$comment: Colour inputs for contrast.test.ts. They live in a .json for the same reason store-palettes.json does, and its comment states it: a .json file can hold no className, no style attribute and no component, which is exactly what `web/no-hex-colors` exists to stop. A test of a hex parser needs hex, and these are data rather than a colour the product chose — putting them here follows the precedent instead of opening an exception in a gate that is at absolute zero.
